title: Controlled OANDA historical acquisition and immutable sealing
objective: Build a practice-only GET historical-candle acquisition and sealing mechanism without binding an undeclared research window, opening the reserved final test, evaluating M005 performance, or granting trading authority.
success_criteria: Acquisition window remains explicitly UNBOUND until a human-approved declaration binds it
Only the OANDA practice account instrument-candles endpoint can be constructed or fetched
Canonical rows bind bid ask and midpoint OHLC plus raw-page hashes
Partial malformed overlapping or mutated evidence fails closed
Credentials are runtime-only and excluded from evidence outputs
Existing sealed output cannot be overwritten
Reserved final-test strategy access remains prohibited
stop_conditions: Any change outside rnd/ or to frozen operational paths
Any live-host or broker write endpoint capability
Any committed credential or credential-bearing evidence
Any M005 performance evaluation parameter optimization strategy ranking or reserved-test opening
Any capital authority automatic promotion or automatic merge
